gloss_en: Malkhut/kingship — the abstract noun מַלְכוּת denoting the sefirah of Kingship/divine sovereignty: the 'lower wisdom' (chokhmah tata'ah) that governs each world, bechinat dalet/nun 'that has nothing of its own' but receives from Chokhmah; identified with speech ('malkhut peh'), prayer, faith, fear/awe, the Shekhinah, honor, and holy kingship (malkhut dikdusha) as opposed to the kingship of the Other Side — not the concrete nouns מֶלֶךְ (king) or מַלְכָּה (queen)
